cards.name: Shining Brigade - Flowering Division

effects.printed_clause: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by shuffling 1 "Shining Brigade" card from your banishment or GY into the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Shining Brigade - Flowering Division" once per turn this way. A "Shining Brigade" monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable hand procedure selects an eligible face-up banished/GY 0x7a34 card during procedure targeting and returns it as Summon cost; oath count limits the procedure.

official_references.official_effect_text: If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand). [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned [b]and[/b] your opponent controls a monster: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster in your GY, except "Moon Gardna"; add it to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

official_references.matched_structure: return GY cards to shuffled Deck
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Target[/b] 5 monsters in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, [b]then[/b] draw 2 cards.

effects.printed_clause:
You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by shuffling 1 "Shining Brigade" card from your banishment or GY into the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Shining Brigade - Flowering Division" once per turn this way. A "Shining Brigade" monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● Once per turn: You can add 1 "Shining Brigade" card from your GY or banishment to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: An EFFECT_TYPE_XMATERIAL Ignition Effect, conditioned on a 0x7a34 holder, has a soft count and adds a GY/face-up banished archetype card.

official_references.official_effect_text:
If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 "Zoodiac" monster in your GY, except "Zoodiac Ramram"; Special Summon it. An Xyz Monster whose original Type is Beast-Warrior [b]and[/b] has this card as material gains this effect.
● [b]When[/b] your opponent activates a Trap Card or effect that targets this card ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] detach 1 material from this card; [b]negate[/b] the activation.
